name: Frame Counter
description: Simple FPS, BPS and total frames counter that turns red when your FPS drops.

enabled.name: Show counter
enabled.description: Show the FPS counter on screen

show-bps.name: Show BPS
show-bps.description: Also show blocks per second while playing a level

show-frames.name: Show total frames
show-frames.description: Also show the total frame count since the game was opened

macro-enabled.name: Macro recorder
macro-enabled.description: Record your inputs with F5, replay every attempt with F6, clear with F7

cbs.name: Click Between Steps
cbs.description: Records and replays inputs at sub-step precision inside each 1/240s tick, using GD's native Click Between Steps option

unlock-fps.name: Unlock FPS
unlock-fps.description: Runs the game at your target FPS so every counted frame is frame-perfect (1/240s each at 240)

target-fps.name: Target FPS
target-fps.description: FPS the game runs at when Unlock FPS is on (2 frames here = 1 frame at 120fps when set to 240)

low-fps.name: Low FPS threshold
low-fps.description: The counter turns red when FPS falls below this
